name: Error handling, retries, and fallback behavior

steps.text: I have a ScraperType configuration with "scraper_engine" set to "requests"
retry policy set to 3 attempts with exponential backoff
a transient network error occurs during fetch
the Scraper should retry up to 3 times before failing
